'''Na'Ilia''' was a [[Tarasin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. On one occasion Na'Ilia helped [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]] record a message on a [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] regarding [[Liriana]] and the [[Wyrd]].
